column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 01 (M24001): mimpi buruk Commander setelah The Elmo dibom,
# M4 memutus keputusasaan itu, lalu Asteria & Dandelion kembali dengan kabar buruk.
# Tetap Inggris: Commander, Vasily, Mokosh, Doll Community, Robin, Hailin, Helen, Helian,
# Ophelunie, Orphia, Chiloveig, Kalina, Ange, Angelia, Machlian, M4, M4A1, AR15, AR-15,
# Asteria, AR Team, Dandelion, The Elmo, Oathguards, Paradeus, Relics, Nirvana,
# Graurizard, Boojum, Nyto, Lviv, Red Zone, Yellow Zone, Barracuda, Frame, Doll.
# Catatan: beberapa baris di file game masih berbahasa Mandarin — ikut diterjemahkan.
(Falling.)
column2: (Terjatuh.)

column1: (Bouncing up.)
column2: (Terpantul naik.)

column1: (Left and right, up and down, front and back—all sense of space seemed to become meaningless in this instant. I wasn't even sure if I was falling or floating upwards.)
column2: (Kiri dan kanan, atas dan bawah, depan dan belakang—semua rasa ruang seolah kehilangan makna dalam sekejap itu. Aku bahkan tidak yakin apakah aku sedang jatuh atau mengapung ke atas.)

column1: (Starting from around my temples, my entire head was in a needle-like stinging pain, and a feeling of nausea kept welling up.)
column2: (Mulai dari sekitar pelipis, seluruh kepalaku ditusuk nyeri seperti jarum, dan rasa mual terus naik.)

column1: (...I don't even really remember what happened.)
column2: (...Aku bahkan tidak begitu ingat apa yang terjadi.)

column1: (I only remember... flames, impact, and the final fall.)
column2: (Aku hanya ingat... kobaran api, benturan, dan jatuh yang terakhir.)

column1: (After that, there was nothing.)
column2: (Setelah itu, tidak ada apa-apa lagi.)

column1: (...It hurts.)
column2: (...Sakit.)

column1: (Every bone in my body felt as if it had been shattered by something. Just opening my eyes exhausted all my strength.)
column2: (Setiap tulang di tubuhku terasa seperti dihancurkan sesuatu. Membuka mata saja menghabiskan seluruh tenagaku.)

column1: (Did I... fail again?)
column2: (Apa aku... gagal lagi?)

column1: Cough... cough...
column2: Uhuk... uhuk...

column1: (My vision was gradually illuminated by the burning firelight.)
column2: (Pandanganku perlahan diterangi cahaya api yang membara.)

column1: (The darkness is dispelled, and what appears before my eyes is Mokosh.)
column2: (Kegelapan tersingkap, dan yang muncul di depan mataku adalah Mokosh.)

column1: (A ruined Mokosh after its fall.)
column2: (Mokosh yang runtuh setelah jatuh.)

column1: (The air is filled with the smell of gunpowder and burning. The buildings in the distance are still on fire, and the thick smoke dyes the entire sky a murky gray—even the dome that sheltered this city has been destroyed beyond recognition at some unknown time.)
column2: (Udaranya dipenuhi bau mesiu dan sesuatu yang terbakar. Bangunan di kejauhan masih menyala, dan asap tebal mewarnai seluruh langit jadi kelabu keruh—bahkan kubah yang dulu menaungi kota ini entah sejak kapan sudah hancur tak berbentuk.)

column1: (I stand amidst the ruins.)
column2: (Aku berdiri di tengah puing-puing.)

column1: No... no...
column2: Tidak... tidak...

column1: ...Hey... Commander...
column2: ...Hei... Commander...

column1: (Ignoring the tearing pain in my muscles and bones, I abruptly turn around, only to see Vasily lying on the ground, covered in blood.)
column2: (Mengabaikan nyeri yang mencabik otot dan tulangku, aku berbalik mendadak, hanya untuk melihat Vasily tergeletak di tanah, bersimbah darah.)

column1: (His voice sounds like it's coming from far away, intermittent, and every word he speaks is accompanied by the gurgling of blood bubbles in his chest.)
column2: (Suaranya terdengar seperti datang dari jauh, terputus-putus, dan setiap kata yang dia ucapkan diiringi gelegak gelembung darah di dadanya.)

column1: Vasily... wait, don't speak, don't—
column2: Vasily... tunggu, jangan bicara, jangan—

column1: (I crouch down, trying to stop the bleeding from his body, but no matter how hard I try, the warm blood continues to spill through my fingers.)
column2: (Aku berjongkok, berusaha menghentikan pendarahan di tubuhnya, tapi sekeras apa pun aku mencoba, darah hangat itu terus meluber lewat celah jariku.)

column1: Don't... don't make that kind of expression, Commander.
column2: Jangan... jangan pasang wajah seperti itu, Commander.

column1: You didn't do anything wrong...
column2: Kau tidak melakukan kesalahan apa pun...

column1: ...Stop talking, stop talking!
column2: ...Berhenti bicara, berhenti bicara!

column1: You know... before you came to Mokosh, I had already accepted my fate.
column2: Kau tahu... sebelum kau datang ke Mokosh, aku sudah menerima takdirku.

column1: I felt like this was it for my life... locked up in a cell until I die, or quietly disappearing one day without a sound.
column2: Aku merasa hidupku cuma sampai di situ... dikurung di sel sampai mati, atau suatu hari hilang begitu saja tanpa suara.

column1: It was you... who made me feel that these days could be changed.
column2: Kaulah... yang membuatku merasa hari-hari itu bisa diubah.

column1: Made me feel... that resisting was meaningful.
column2: Membuatku merasa... melawan itu ada artinya.

column1: So... don't blame yourself, Commander.
column2: Jadi... jangan menyalahkan dirimu, Commander.

column1: You've already... done well enough...
column2: Kau sudah... melakukan cukup banyak...

column1: (I looked at Vasily anxiously, trying to stop his life from slipping through my hands.)
column2: (Aku menatap Vasily dengan gelisah, berusaha menahan nyawanya agar tidak lolos dari tanganku.)

column1: (But he just looked at me like that, the corners of his mouth slightly raised, smiling, as if he was completely satisfied with everything.)
column2: (Tapi dia hanya menatapku seperti itu, sudut mulutnya terangkat sedikit, tersenyum, seolah dia benar-benar puas dengan semuanya.)

column1: (Then his figure began to become transparent, as if being blown away bit by bit by the wind.)
column2: (Lalu tubuhnya mulai menjadi tembus pandang, seolah diterbangkan angin sedikit demi sedikit.)

column1: No... no...! Vasily!
column2: Tidak... tidak...! Vasily!

column1: It's not like this... it's not...!!
column2: Bukan seperti ini... bukan...!!

column1: I clearly—I clearly could have...
column2: Aku jelas—aku jelas bisa...

column1: (I try to grab his body, but my hands only grasp empty air.)
column2: (Aku mencoba menggenggam tubuhnya, tapi tanganku hanya meraih udara kosong.)

column1: (Just like my voice, echoing over the desolate and ruined wasteland, eventually vanishing without a trace.)
column2: (Seperti suaraku sendiri, bergaung di atas tanah gersang yang runtuh, lalu akhirnya hilang tanpa jejak.)

column1: (The ruins of Mokosh, along with Vasily's figure, shattered together, turning into countless tiny specks of light that were swept into a new darkness.)
column2: (Puing Mokosh, bersama tubuh Vasily, hancur bersamaan, berubah menjadi bintik-bintik cahaya tak terhitung yang tersapu ke dalam kegelapan baru.)

column1: (My body began to fall once again, and this time, from the darkness, countless hands grabbed me tightly, as if trying to tear me apart and peer into my flesh and blood.)
column2: (Tubuhku mulai jatuh sekali lagi, dan kali ini, dari dalam kegelapan, tangan-tangan tak terhitung mencengkeramku kuat, seolah ingin mencabik-cabikku dan mengintip ke dalam darah dan dagingku.)

column1: (...I can hear them, those voices.)
column2: (...Aku bisa mendengarnya, suara-suara itu.)

column1: (I can see them, those endings that were ultimately smeared with filth.)
column2: (Aku bisa melihatnya, akhir-akhir yang pada akhirnya tercemar kotoran.)

column1: 谢谢你，指挥官。
column2: Terima kasih, Commander.

column1: If it weren't for you, the Doll Community wouldn't have made it to today.
column2: Kalau bukan karena kau, Doll Community tidak akan sampai ke hari ini.

column1: ...No... I'm the one who dragged you into this.
column2: ...Tidak... akulah yang menarik kalian ke dalam ini.

column1: It's because of me... that you were dragged into this kind of war.
column2: Karena akulah... kalian terseret ke perang seperti ini.

column1: Don't always treat me like a child, Commander.
column2: Jangan selalu memperlakukanku seperti anak kecil, Commander.

column1: I... know what I'm doing.
column2: Aku... tahu apa yang kulakukan.

column1: No... you shouldn't... you could have a better life...
column2: Tidak... kau seharusnya tidak... kau bisa punya hidup yang lebih baik...

column1: —Thank you, Robin.
column2: —Terima kasih, Robin.
...Tidak, tidak... tidak...

column1: (Darkness has no weight, and sound has no physical form.)
column2: (Kegelapan tidak punya bobot, dan suara tidak punya bentuk fisik.)

column1: (But I am still crushed breathless by an invisible weight.)
column2: (Tapi aku tetap dihimpit sampai kehabisan napas oleh beban yang tak terlihat.)

column1: (And in this endless abyss, a familiar voice slowly emerged.)
column2: (Dan di jurang tanpa dasar itu, sebuah suara yang kukenal perlahan muncul.)

column1: (She is very close to me, her movements light, as if pulling me into her embrace, gently stroking the top of my head and whispering softly in my ear.)
column2: (Dia sangat dekat denganku, gerakannya ringan, seolah menarikku ke dalam pelukannya, mengusap lembut puncak kepalaku dan berbisik lirih di telingaku.)

column1: ...You, when are you going to change this awful temper of yours?
column2: ...Kau ini, kapan mau mengubah watakmu yang menyusahkan itu?

column1: (A warm palm covers my eyes.)
column2: (Sebuah telapak tangan yang hangat menutupi mataku.)

column1: You're clearly about to collapse, yet you still want to shoulder everything.
column2: Kau jelas hampir tumbang, tapi masih mau memikul semuanya.

column1: Surprised? Big Sis came to see you.
column2: Kaget? Big Sis datang menemuimu.
Aku...

column1: Why the long face... Can't even talk back anymore?
column2: Kenapa wajahmu begitu... sudah tidak bisa membalas lagi?

column1: ...Don't be afraid.
column2: ...Jangan takut.

column1: ...You've already done very well.
column2: ...Kau sudah melakukannya dengan sangat baik.
(...Tidak.)

column1: No...
column2: Tidak...

column1: No... it's not like that...
column2: Tidak... bukan seperti itu...

column1: (The hand covering my eyes let go.)
column2: (Tangan yang menutupi mataku terlepas.)

column1: (I saw her.)
column2: (Aku melihatnya.)

column1: (Her face was exactly the same as in my memory, without any changes—forever frozen on that day.)
column2: (Wajahnya sama persis seperti dalam ingatanku, tanpa perubahan apa pun—selamanya membeku di hari itu.)

column1: ...No one can blame you, you've already put in all your effort.
column2: ...Tidak ada yang bisa menyalahkanmu, kau sudah mengerahkan seluruh usahamu.

column1: So...
column2: Jadi...

column1: Don't cry.
column2: Jangan menangis.

column1: (Her voice was so soft, so close. Her fingers brushed across my forehead, her eyes filled with pity for me.)
column2: (Suaranya begitu lembut, begitu dekat. Jarinya menyapu dahiku, matanya penuh rasa kasihan padaku.)

column1: (—I felt as if something had shattered in my heart.)
column2: (—Aku merasa ada sesuatu yang pecah di dalam hatiku.)

column1: I didn't... I couldn't do anything...
column2: Aku tidak... aku tidak bisa melakukan apa pun...

column1: (I wanted to say something more, but no sound came out.)
column2: (Aku ingin mengatakan sesuatu lagi, tapi tidak ada suara yang keluar.)

column1: (Everything before my eyes was collapsing—Helen's face also turned into a suffocating nothingness.)
column2: (Semua yang ada di depan mataku runtuh—wajah Helen pun berubah menjadi ketiadaan yang menyesakkan.)

column1: (I fell to my knees in the darkness, my heavy body feeling like it was going to crush me.)
column2: (Aku bersimpuh di dalam kegelapan, tubuhku yang berat terasa seperti akan menghancurkanku sendiri.)

column1: (...I didn't protect Mokosh well, I didn't save Vasily.)
column2: (...Aku tidak melindungi Mokosh dengan baik, aku tidak menyelamatkan Vasily.)

column1: (I didn't protect Ophelunie well, I didn't stop Chiloveig.)
column2: (Aku tidak melindungi Ophelunie dengan baik, aku tidak menghentikan Chiloveig.)

column1: (The Doll Community misplaced their trust in me, and Kalina also walked a difficult path because of me.)
column2: (Doll Community salah menaruh kepercayaan padaku, dan Kalina juga menempuh jalan yang sulit karena aku.)

column1: (...I didn't save Ange, I didn't save Machlian, and those who once trusted me.)
column2: (...Aku tidak menyelamatkan Ange, tidak menyelamatkan Machlian, dan mereka yang pernah memercayaiku.)

column1: (I failed to practice the beliefs and missions Helian entrusted to me.)
column2: (Aku gagal menjalankan keyakinan dan misi yang dipercayakan Helian kepadaku.)

column1: (...What exactly have I done?)
column2: (...Sebenarnya apa yang sudah kulakukan?)

column1: (Why is no one blaming me? Why is no one accusing me?)
column2: (Kenapa tidak ada yang menyalahkanku? Kenapa tidak ada yang menuntutku?)

column1: (Why... do they all say I've done well enough.)
column2: (Kenapa... mereka semua bilang aku sudah melakukan cukup banyak.)

column1: (If it was really enough, why...)
column2: (Kalau memang cukup, kenapa...)

column1: ...Why are more and more people getting hurt.
column2: ...Kenapa makin banyak orang yang terluka.

column1: Why... are you all gone, and only I am still alive?
column2: Kenapa... kalian semua pergi, dan hanya aku yang masih hidup?

column1: (With my whispers, the darkness also began to continuously shrink.)
column2: (Bersama bisikanku, kegelapan itu juga mulai terus menyusut.)

column1: (My consciousness is being swallowed by some massive void—)
column2: (Kesadaranku sedang ditelan kekosongan raksasa—)

column1: (...I feel an intense exhaustion constantly welling up.)
column2: (...Aku merasakan kelelahan yang hebat terus naik.)

column1: (So tired...)
column2: (Lelah sekali...)

column1: (This time... it seems... it's really going to end...)
column2: (Kali ini... sepertinya... benar-benar akan berakhir...)

column1: —It's not over yet.
column2: —Ini belum berakhir.

column1: (—Just then, a clear voice pierced through the darkness.)
column2: (—Tepat saat itu, sebuah suara yang jernih menembus kegelapan.)

column1: (Like a sharp blade, it cleaved through the nothingness that was devouring me.)
column2: (Seperti bilah tajam, suara itu membelah ketiadaan yang sedang menelanku.)

column1: It's not over yet—Commander.
column2: Ini belum berakhir—Commander.

column1: (I suddenly jolted awake from the darkness.)
column2: (Aku tersentak bangun dari kegelapan.)

column1: (Threads of light extended beneath my feet, weaving into countless intersecting tree shadows.)
column2: (Benang-benang cahaya memanjang di bawah kakiku, merajut bayangan pepohonan yang tak terhitung dan saling silang.)

column1: (After the familiar voice... was a familiar figure, standing right in front of me.)
column2: (Setelah suara yang kukenal itu... muncul figur yang kukenal, berdiri tepat di depanku.)

column1: (Her eyes reflected a certain radiance that didn't belong to the mortal world, but the way she looked at me was incredibly warm and incredibly real.)
column2: (Matanya memantulkan cahaya yang tidak berasal dari dunia fana, tapi cara dia menatapku begitu hangat dan begitu nyata.)

column1: (I clutched my chest with lingering fear, my consciousness still unable to recover from the trance.)
column2: (Aku mencengkeram dadaku dengan rasa takut yang belum reda, kesadaranku masih belum pulih dari kekacauan itu.)

column1: (It wasn't until this moment that I finally recalled what had just happened.)
column2: (Baru pada saat itu aku akhirnya mengingat apa yang baru saja terjadi.)

column1: Mokosh... The Elmo... How is everyone!?
column2: Mokosh... The Elmo... Bagaimana keadaan semuanya!?

column1: ...Please don't panic.
column2: ...Tolong jangan panik.

column1: (It wasn't until this moment that I noticed a hint of sternness in M4's demeanor.)
column2: (Baru pada saat itu aku menyadari ada sedikit ketegasan dalam sikap M4.)

column1: 我看到了。
column2: Aku melihatnya.

column1: What you just experienced... or rather, those illusions you feared... I saw them all.
column2: Yang baru saja kau alami... atau lebih tepatnya, ilusi-ilusi yang kau takuti itu... aku melihat semuanya.

column1: Do you feel like you haven't achieved anything?
column2: Kau merasa belum mencapai apa pun?

column1: Do you think Mokosh, The Elmo, Kalina—those who have died, and those who are fighting, have all ended up like this because of you?
column2: Kau merasa Mokosh, The Elmo, Kalina—mereka yang sudah mati, dan mereka yang masih bertarung, berakhir seperti ini karena kau?

column1: You think you are unworthy and undeserving of any gratitude or admiration.
column2: Kau merasa dirimu tidak layak dan tidak pantas menerima rasa terima kasih atau kekaguman apa pun.

column1: Because you didn't accomplish anything, right?
column2: Karena kau tidak mencapai apa pun, kan?
Aku...

column1: (Her voice wasn't loud, but the power it contained made my words come to an abrupt halt.)
column2: (Suaranya tidak keras, tapi kekuatan di dalamnya membuat kata-kataku terhenti mendadak.)

column1: Please listen to me.
column2: Tolong dengarkan aku.

column1: Mokosh hasn't fallen yet, and Vasily isn't dead either.
column2: Mokosh belum jatuh, dan Vasily juga belum mati.

column1: The Oathguards are still fighting—not for you, but for themselves.
column2: Oathguards masih bertarung—bukan untukmu, tapi untuk diri mereka sendiri.

column1: Before you went to Mokosh, they didn't even have the courage to resist.
column2: Sebelum kau datang ke Mokosh, mereka bahkan tidak punya keberanian untuk melawan.

column1: Now, they know what they are fighting for, and even if they have to sacrifice their lives, they will not hesitate.
column2: Sekarang, mereka tahu untuk apa mereka bertarung, dan meski harus mengorbankan nyawa, mereka tidak akan ragu.

column1: It was you who allowed them to die as warriors rather than slaves in the final moments of their lives.
column2: Kaulah yang membuat mereka bisa mati sebagai pejuang, bukan sebagai budak, di saat-saat terakhir hidup mereka.

column1: ...And that matter you've always been unable to let go of... Miss Orphia's existence... has indeed faded away.
column2: ...Dan urusan yang selalu tidak bisa kau lepaskan itu... eksistensi Miss Orphia... memang sudah memudar.

column1: But—if it weren't for you, she would have only been a tool in someone else's hands until her death.
column2: Tapi—kalau bukan karena kau, dia hanya akan jadi alat di tangan orang lain sampai kematiannya.

column1: Heading towards a sorrowful end with power and a mission that didn't belong to her.
column2: Melangkah ke akhir yang menyedihkan dengan kekuatan dan misi yang bukan miliknya.

column1: It was you who made her realize who she was, made her choose to face her past mistakes, and take on her own responsibilities.
column2: Kaulah yang membuatnya menyadari siapa dirinya, membuatnya memilih menghadapi kesalahan masa lalunya, dan memikul tanggung jawabnya sendiri.

column1: The sacrifice she made was out of her own free will—not anyone's orders.
column2: Pengorbanan yang dia lakukan berasal dari kehendaknya sendiri—bukan perintah siapa pun.

column1: Also... at the moment Angelia passed away, there was no fear or regret in her heart.
column2: Dan juga... di saat Angelia meninggal, tidak ada rasa takut atau penyesalan di hatinya.

column1: Because she knew that on the path she walked, there would be others who would continue forward without hesitation.
column2: Karena dia tahu di jalan yang dia tempuh, akan ada orang lain yang terus melangkah maju tanpa ragu.

column1: Commander, don't you understand?
column2: Commander, kau belum paham?

column1: It's not just them.
column2: Bukan cuma mereka.

column1: Up to today, up to this very moment, you have saved countless lives.
column2: Sampai hari ini, sampai detik ini, kau sudah menyelamatkan nyawa yang tak terhitung.

column1: Whether Dolls or humans, those you pulled out of the darkness, every single one of them is proof that you 'did it'.
column2: Baik Doll maupun manusia, mereka yang kau tarik keluar dari kegelapan, setiap satu dari mereka adalah bukti bahwa kau 'berhasil'.

column1: (The distant, divine-like radiance in her eyes faded away.)
column2: (Cahaya bak dewa yang jauh di matanya memudar.)

column1: (Replaced by the incredibly familiar gentleness that belongs only to M4A1.)
column2: (Digantikan kelembutan yang teramat kukenal, yang hanya milik M4A1.)

column1: ...I don't know, was it me who did it, or was it you?
column2: ...Aku tidak tahu, apa itu aku yang melakukannya, atau kau?

column1: Since ten years ago... I've always had this question.
column2: Sejak sepuluh tahun lalu... pertanyaan itu selalu ada di kepalaku.

column1: Is everything I've done a path you set for me, or did I choose it myself?
column2: Apakah semua yang kulakukan adalah jalan yang kau siapkan untukku, atau aku sendiri yang memilihnya?

column1: If you really can do anything, why don't you save more people?
column2: Kalau kau benar-benar bisa melakukan apa saja, kenapa tidak menyelamatkan lebih banyak orang?

column1: (M4 shook her head, revealing a somewhat bitter smile.)
column2: (M4 menggeleng, menampakkan senyum yang agak pahit.)

column1: I can't explain it to you in detail, but I can give you answers to some simple facts.
column2: Aku tidak bisa menjelaskannya secara rinci padamu, tapi aku bisa memberi jawaban untuk beberapa fakta sederhana.

column1: From beginning to end, I am merely observing the world, not omnipotently adjusting it according to my whims.
column2: Dari awal sampai akhir, aku hanya mengamati dunia, bukan mengatur ulangnya sesuka hatiku dengan kuasa mutlak.

column1: If I truly had the ability to write all futures for you, yet left you in your current predicament.
column2: Kalau aku benar-benar mampu menuliskan semua masa depan untukmu, tapi tetap membiarkanmu dalam keadaan sekarang.

column1: Then... I was still too cruel to you.
column2: Maka... aku terlalu kejam padamu.

column1: Undoubtedly, all your choices, salvation, and efforts stem from your own strength.
column2: Tidak diragukan, semua pilihan, penyelamatan, dan usahamu berasal dari kekuatanmu sendiri.

column1: Moreover... now, the situation has also changed greatly compared to before.
column2: Lebih dari itu... sekarang, situasinya juga sudah sangat berbeda dari sebelumnya.

column1: ...What does that mean?
column2: ...Apa maksudnya?

column1: 'Observation' has failed.
column2: 'Pengamatan' itu gagal.

column1: Failed?
column2: Gagal?

column1: I once told you that I have been using my power, trying to find an ending that would allow you, and the world, to continue.
column2: Aku pernah bilang bahwa aku terus memakai kekuatanku, mencari akhir yang memungkinkan kau, dan dunia ini, tetap berlanjut.

column1: But I don't know since when, my vision has been interfered with by some 'unknown'... becoming a chaotic blur.
column2: Tapi entah sejak kapan, penglihatanku diganggu sesuatu yang 'tak dikenal'... jadi kabur dan kacau.

column1: I tried to find a path within it that could continue...
column2: Aku berusaha mencari satu jalan di dalamnya yang masih bisa dilanjutkan...

column1: But the end of every thread is shrouded in an unknown darkness.
column2: Tapi ujung setiap benangnya tertutup kegelapan yang tak dikenal.

column1: This kind of darkness is something I have never seen before. Rather than an end, it is more like a kind of nothingness...
column2: Kegelapan semacam itu belum pernah kulihat sebelumnya. Bukannya sebuah akhir, itu lebih mirip semacam ketiadaan...

column1: The nothingness that counteracts the power of the "Relics."
column2: Ketiadaan yang meniadakan kekuatan "Relics."

column1: I guess some kind of change must have occurred in the anchor point, leading to the birth of this darkness.
column2: Dugaanku, pasti ada perubahan di titik jangkarnya, yang melahirkan kegelapan ini.

column1: So... Commander, you should have already understood...
column2: Jadi... Commander, seharusnya kau sudah paham...

column1: From now on, even if I exhaust all my power, I can no longer intervene in your fate.
column2: Mulai sekarang, meski aku menguras seluruh kekuatanku, aku tidak bisa lagi ikut campur dalam takdirmu.

column1: You must... well, just like those who were inspired by you, fight for yourself.
column2: Kau harus... yah, seperti mereka yang terinspirasi olehmu, bertarung untuk dirimu sendiri.

column1: Your battle is not over yet.
column2: Pertarunganmu belum berakhir.

column1: There are still people ahead waiting for you to return.
column2: Masih ada orang di depan yang menunggumu kembali.

column1: And you—
column2: Dan kau—

column1: I will absolutely not fall here.
column2: Aku sama sekali tidak akan tumbang di sini.

column1: Right?
column2: Kan?

column1: (I stood up, wanting to grasp the hand she extended to me.)
column2: (Aku berdiri, ingin menggenggam tangan yang dia ulurkan padaku.)

column1: M4, I—
column2: M4, aku—

column1: (But her figure began to dissipate the moment I touched her.)
column2: (Tapi tubuhnya mulai memudar begitu aku menyentuhnya.)

column1: (Threads of light surged beneath her feet, lifting her away little by little.)
column2: (Benang-benang cahaya mengalir di bawah kakinya, mengangkatnya menjauh sedikit demi sedikit.)

column1: Everyone and I...
column2: Aku dan semuanya...

column1: Will always be guarding by your side...
column2: Akan selalu menjaga di sisimu...

column1: (My hand passed through the threads of light, grasping nothing—)
column2: (Tanganku melewati benang-benang cahaya itu, tanpa menggenggam apa pun—)

column1: (But my fingers did indeed touch something warm and familiar.)
column2: (Tapi ujung jariku memang menyentuh sesuatu yang hangat dan kukenal.)

column1: Oh my, you're finally awake.
column2: Wah, akhirnya kau bangun.

column1: Although our faces look very similar... mistaking me for Big Sis is still a bit much.
column2: Meski wajah kami sangat mirip... salah mengiraku sebagai Big Sis itu tetap agak berlebihan.

column1: (I looked down and found myself gripping Dandelion's sleeve.)
column2: (Aku menunduk dan menemukan diriku menggenggam lengan baju Dandelion.)

column1: Dandelion...? No, this Frame...
column2: Dandelion...? Bukan, Frame ini...

column1: You... you're back?
column2: Kau... kau kembali?

column1: Yeah, although I'd love to explain the whole story, there's no time for idle chatter right now.
column2: Iya, meski aku ingin menjelaskan semuanya, sekarang tidak ada waktu untuk mengobrol santai.

column1: Alright, look, who's here?
column2: Sudah, lihat, siapa yang datang?

column1: (Dandelion stepped aside, revealing a long-unseen face behind her.)
column2: (Dandelion menyingkir ke samping, memperlihatkan wajah yang lama tak terlihat di belakangnya.)

column1: Commander... sorry, it seems I'm a bit late.
column2: Commander... maaf, sepertinya aku agak terlambat.

column1: Can you still move?
column2: Kau masih bisa bergerak?

column1: Wait, am I... am I still dreaming...
column2: Tunggu, apa aku... apa aku masih bermimpi...

column1: Although you're heavily injured... you're more awake now than ever.
column2: Meski lukamu berat... sekarang kau lebih sadar dari kapan pun.

column1: It's really me, I'm back.
column2: Ini memang aku, aku sudah kembali.

column1: AR-15—no, my current codename is "Asteria," requesting to rejoin the team, Commander.
column2: AR-15—bukan, kode namaku sekarang "Asteria," mengajukan permohonan bergabung kembali ke tim, Commander.

column1: Welcome back.
column2: Selamat datang kembali.

column1: Speaking of which, where have you been all these years?
column2: Ngomong-ngomong, ke mana saja kau bertahun-tahun ini?

column1: I went to many places to investigate certain things.
column2: Aku pergi ke banyak tempat untuk menyelidiki beberapa hal.

column1: I guess you should know... what I'm referring to.
column2: Kurasa kau tahu... apa yang kumaksud.

column1: ...Is it related to M4?
column2: ...Apa ini berkaitan dengan M4?

column1: It's also related to you.
column2: Berkaitan denganmu juga.

column1: But these things caused me to be unable to rush to your side immediately...
column2: Tapi hal-hal itu membuatku tidak bisa langsung berlari ke sisimu...

column1: Looking at it now, it really won't do without me by your side.
column2: Melihat keadaan sekarang, memang tidak bisa kalau aku tidak di sisimu.

column1: I'm glad you're back.
column2: Aku senang kau kembali.

column1: Asteria, tell me about your findings.
column2: Asteria, ceritakan temuanmu.

column1: The information I've obtained might not be as in-depth as your investigation...
column2: Informasi yang kudapat mungkin tidak sedalam penyelidikanmu...

column1: After all, M4 didn't disclose everything to me like she did to you.
column2: Lagi pula M4 tidak membuka semuanya kepadaku seperti kepadamu.

column1: She must have her reasons for doing this.
column2: Dia pasti punya alasan untuk itu.

column1: Perhaps... from the results, that is indeed the case.
column2: Mungkin... dari hasilnya, memang begitu.

column1: But her methods certainly couldn't be called gentle.
column2: Tapi caranya jelas tidak bisa disebut lembut.

column1: Over the years, I've been following in her footsteps to investigate, but I've walked a completely different path from you.
column2: Selama bertahun-tahun ini aku mengikuti jejaknya untuk menyelidiki, tapi jalanku sepenuhnya berbeda dari jalanmu.

column1: But perhaps it's exactly because of this that I had the opportunity to see another "truth" of the whole matter—
column2: Tapi mungkin justru karena itulah aku punya kesempatan melihat "kebenaran" lain dari seluruh urusan ini—

column1: The identity of the enemy you are facing.
column2: Identitas musuh yang kau hadapi.

column1: Identity... isn't it Paradeus?
column2: Identitas... bukan Paradeus?

column1: It seems we all underestimated those guys.
column2: Sepertinya kita semua meremehkan mereka.

column1: From the conclusions of my investigation, Paradeus is merely their spokesperson in this world.
column2: Dari kesimpulan penyelidikanku, Paradeus hanyalah juru bicara mereka di dunia ini.

column1: Behind the scenes, there is some unknown existence... It, or rather 'they', are the true culprits manipulating everything.
column2: Di belakang panggung ada eksistensi tak dikenal... Dia, atau lebih tepatnya 'mereka', adalah dalang sebenarnya yang mengatur semuanya.

column1: (Asteria's words reminded me of the "dream" from just now.)
column2: (Kata-kata Asteria mengingatkanku pada "mimpi" tadi.)

column1: ('At the end of darkness and nothingness... is the oldest nemesis of civilization, known as the 'Relics'.')
column2: ('Di ujung kegelapan dan ketiadaan... ada musuh tertua peradaban, yang dikenal sebagai 'Relics'.')

column1: The existence behind Paradeus... could it be...
column2: Eksistensi di belakang Paradeus... jangan-jangan...

column1: (Thinking of the previous encounter in the Red Zone, I suddenly realized something.)
column2: (Mengingat pertemuan sebelumnya di Red Zone, aku tiba-tiba menyadari sesuatu.)

column1: Commander, you are heavily injured, so... I don't want to drain your mental energy at a time like this.
column2: Commander, lukamu berat, jadi... aku tidak ingin menguras tenaga pikiranmu di saat seperti ini.

column1: But I want to tell you some fragments of the 'truth'... so you can be prepared for what might happen next.
column2: Tapi aku ingin memberitahumu beberapa pecahan 'kebenaran'... supaya kau siap menghadapi apa yang mungkin terjadi berikutnya.

column1: Well, go ahead.
column2: Baik, katakan saja.

column1: From the moment that dragon named Graurizard appeared in Mokosh, I knew this war wouldn't be that simple.
column2: Sejak naga bernama Graurizard itu muncul di Mokosh, aku tahu perang ini tidak akan sesederhana itu.

column1: Your assessment is very accurate.
column2: Penilaianmu sangat akurat.

column1: The purpose of this war is not just an ordinary counter-rebellion.
column2: Tujuan perang ini bukan cuma penumpasan pemberontakan biasa.

column1: Someone is, or will be, using it to achieve their own goals.
column2: Ada yang sedang, atau akan, memakainya untuk mencapai tujuan mereka sendiri.

column1: That includes the annoying existence I just mentioned.
column2: Termasuk eksistensi menjengkelkan yang baru kusebut.

column1: Whether it's the dragon Graurizard or those Boojum Dolls, they are all under the control of those guys.
column2: Baik naga Graurizard maupun Doll Boojum itu, semuanya ada di bawah kendali mereka.

column1: What happens next will likely surpass your understanding of the world.
column2: Apa yang terjadi berikutnya kemungkinan melampaui pemahamanmu tentang dunia ini.

column1: And what you need to face might be something even more difficult to understand and more cruel than everything that has happened in the past.
column2: Dan yang harus kau hadapi mungkin lebih sulit dipahami dan lebih kejam dari semua yang pernah terjadi di masa lalu.

column1: Are you prepared?
column2: Kau sudah siap?

column1: Asteria, I'm certain I'm prepared.
column2: Asteria, aku yakin aku sudah siap.

column1: Please tell me everything you know, one by one.
column2: Tolong ceritakan semua yang kau tahu, satu per satu.

column1: Mhm... Then I'll tell you.
column2: Mhm... Kalau begitu akan kuceritakan.

column1: When I was investigating this matter before, I happened to encounter a very difficult Boojum lifeform, and...
column2: Saat menyelidiki urusan ini dulu, aku kebetulan berhadapan dengan satu bentuk kehidupan Boojum yang sangat sulit, dan...

column1: A Nyto researcher.
column2: Seorang peneliti Nyto.

column1: I didn't find any data on the Boojum lifeform, but I heard from their conversation that her codename is "Ateraxis."
column2: Aku tidak menemukan data soal bentuk kehidupan Boojum itu, tapi dari percakapan mereka kudengar kode namanya "Ateraxis."

column1: And that Nyto researcher... according to the information I have, she should be the one who instigated the Lviv incident before, a person named Chiloveig.
column2: Dan peneliti Nyto itu... menurut informasi yang kupunya, dia adalah orang yang dulu memicu insiden Lviv, bernama Chiloveig.

column1: Chiloveig... and... Ateraxis?
column2: Chiloveig... dan... Ateraxis?

column1: To think those two would get mixed up together...
column2: Tak kusangka keduanya bisa berbaur jadi satu...

column1: (And what surprised me even more was that Chiloveig was actually still alive.)
column2: (Dan yang lebih mengejutkanku, Chiloveig ternyata masih hidup.)

column1: (After the Lviv incident, I've only seen this name in the news. And in official reports, the descriptions of her all say she went missing in a laboratory explosion, her whereabouts unknown.)
column2: (Setelah insiden Lviv, aku hanya melihat nama itu di berita. Dan di laporan resmi, semua keterangan tentangnya menyebut dia hilang dalam ledakan laboratorium, keberadaannya tidak diketahui.)

column1: From what I've heard, these two getting together seems to be an attempt to use you and The Elmo... to reopen Nirvana.
column2: Dari yang kudengar, kedua orang itu bersatu sepertinya untuk memanfaatkanmu dan The Elmo... demi membuka kembali Nirvana.

column1: I guessed this isn't something you'd want to happen, so I hurried here as quickly as possible.
column2: Kuduga itu bukan hal yang kau inginkan, jadi aku bergegas ke sini secepat mungkin.

column1: This bombing of The Elmo really wasn't that simple.
column2: Pengeboman The Elmo ini memang tidak sesederhana itu.

column1: At first, I just thought the development of this war was very strange, but with you saying that, it makes sense.
column2: Awalnya kupikir jalannya perang ini cuma aneh, tapi dengan penjelasanmu, semuanya masuk akal.

column1: Whether it's Ateraxis, or Chiloveig... or even the forces that ordered the bombing of The Elmo, the result they want is to restart the relic experiments.
column2: Baik Ateraxis, maupun Chiloveig... bahkan pihak yang memerintahkan pengeboman The Elmo, hasil yang mereka inginkan adalah menyalakan ulang eksperimen relic.

column1: This way, the fact that the Barracuda was tampered with also makes sense.
column2: Dengan begitu, fakta bahwa Barracuda diutak-atik juga masuk akal.

column1: Yes. Commander, you should understand now that The Elmo has become a target anchored by various factions.
column2: Benar. Commander, sekarang kau seharusnya paham bahwa The Elmo sudah menjadi sasaran yang dijangkar berbagai faksi.

column1: We must handle this carefully.
column2: Kita harus menanganinya dengan hati-hati.

column1: So don't risk your life like before.
column2: Jadi jangan mempertaruhkan nyawamu seperti sebelumnya.

column1: ...It's okay if you can't do it.
column2: ...Tidak masalah kalau kau tidak sanggup.

column1: I... and the AR Team, will face everything that comes next with you.
column2: Aku... dan AR Team, akan menghadapi semua yang datang berikutnya bersamamu.

column1: You just need to give us orders, that's enough.
column2: Kau hanya perlu memberi kami perintah, itu sudah cukup.

column1: (Asteria held my hand tightly. We haven't seen each other in ten years, and I really wanted to chat more with her about our respective experiences over these years...)
column2: (Asteria menggenggam tanganku erat. Kami tidak bertemu sepuluh tahun, dan aku sangat ingin bercerita lebih banyak dengannya soal pengalaman kami masing-masing selama ini...)

column1: (But right now, there are more pressing matters before us.)
column2: (Tapi sekarang, ada urusan yang lebih mendesak di depan kami.)

column1: By the way, Asteria, when did you rush over here?
column2: Ngomong-ngomong, Asteria, kapan kau bergegas datang ke sini?

column1: How is everyone doing?
column2: Bagaimana keadaan semuanya?

column1: (Asteria's silence raises an ominous premonition in my heart.)
column2: (Diamnya Asteria memunculkan pertanda buruk di hatiku.)

column1: I'm sorry, Commander... After Mokosh fell, the blockade of the Yellow Zone became even tighter.
column2: Maafkan aku, Commander... Setelah Mokosh jatuh, blokade Yellow Zone jadi makin ketat.

column1: By the time I arrived, The Elmo had already been bombed, and everyone was...
column2: Saat aku sampai, The Elmo sudah dibom, dan semuanya...

column1: Dandelion and I only had time to settle the injured Dolls and try our best to salvage everyone's backups...
column2: Aku dan Dandelion hanya sempat mengurus Doll yang terluka dan berusaha sebisa mungkin menyelamatkan backup semua orang...

column1: But still...
column2: Tapi tetap saja...

column1: What's that supposed to mean?
column2: Apa maksudnya itu?

column1: Why would backup data be used...
column2: Kenapa data backup harus dipakai...

column1: ……丹德莱？
column2: ...Dandelion?

column1: Ah... Am I the one who has to answer such an embarrassing question...?
column2: Ah... Apa aku yang harus menjawab pertanyaan seberat itu...?

column1: Commander, just as Miss Asteria said just now.
column2: Commander, seperti yang baru dikatakan Miss Asteria.

column1: The current situation is very grim. I think... it's necessary for you to see it with your own eyes.
column2: Situasi sekarang sangat buruk. Kurasa... kau perlu melihatnya dengan mata sendiri.
